 Filipe Luis says Monaco’s level depends on improving on the ball and in duels at Le Mans 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article AS Monaco look to steady themselves at Le Mans on Sunday, with Filipe Luis urging improvements after a complicated league defeat and a midweek Conference League win.
 According to Nice-Matin, Monaco lost 3-1 at Paris FC on matchday nine, then beat Nordsjaelland 2-0 on Thursday to make it three wins from three in the Conference League. Kick-off at Le Mans is 17:15 in Ligue 1 on matchday 10, and they know it will take more if they are to hope to finish in the domestic top three.
 OneFootball Videos
 Luis wants a side with a defined identity, competitive and pressing high. He says their level depends on being much better with the ball, pressing better and winning duels, and he hopes to see the best version of his team.
 He accepts inconsistency has been an issue, noting a very young squad, new arrivals and the different demands of home and away. Work is ongoing, he says, on mentality and tactical approach to find stability and avoid swings in form.
 Le Mans impressed early in the season but have lost three of four since the last international break. Even so, Luis expects a demanding test against a side that presses high, is defensively solid and, much like Nordsjaelland, is very comfortable on the ball, which will require a big collective effort.
 Stanis Idumbo, psoas, and Ansu Fati, thigh, remain sidelined.
 Source: Nice-Matin
